detail: 0.75% of the tag a day after the 7-day wait, for all stock. Launch jump start: stock on the floor counts as half its real age, at most 45 days. Not scanned in the last inventory and not processed since: back stock, no Member Price. Back stock reaching the floor matches its look-alikes (day 1 if none). Smooth pacing per family (see the pacing decision). Floor stays 10% of the tag.
title: Member Price rules v2 (behind the Thrift+ switch)
